Title: Inventory API - Reserve Stock
Preconditions: Product with available stock
Steps:
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/inventory/products/{id} to record initial inStockQuantity
[CAPTURE] Record initial inStockQuantity
[ACT] Place an order for {{TEST_SKU}} (create cart, add item, checkout) to consume stock — no /reserve endpoint exists on the Inventory module
[WAIT] Wait for order creation confirmation
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/inventory/products/{id} to verify stock decreased
[ASSERT] Verify inStockQuantity decreased by the ordered quantity
[ACT] PATCH {{BACK_URL}}/api/inventory/{id} to restore inStockQuantity to its initial value
[WAIT] Wait for adjustment confirmation
Assertions:
[STATE] Order creation returns 200/201
[MATH] inStockQuantity after order = inStockQuantity before order - ordered quantity
[STATE] PATCH inventory adjustment returns 200/204
[MATH] inStockQuantity after PATCH restore = inStockQuantity before order
Cross_Layer_Checks: [API] HTTP status 200/201 for order creation; 200/204 for PATCH adjustment; [NETWORK] Both requests complete without timeout; [ADMIN] Inventory module reflects the order-driven decrease and PATCH restore
Failure_Signals: Order creation fails with 4xx/5xx; inStockQuantity does not decrease after order; Stock not restored after PATCH adjustment
